label: lawyer or attorney for
definition: Argument 1 serves as a lawyer, attorney or legal counsel for organization or person 2, including employment at a law firm.
scope_notes: The aggregate lawyer/attorney/counsel family is chosen from a mixed professional-role dictionary. A professor, analyst, economist or director without legal representation evidence does not qualify. A firm partner without a legal-role attachment is ambiguous.

facts.reason: Fine is an analyst, strategist or economist for Chase Securities; none of the local rows identifies legal representation.
Goldstein is explicitly lawyer and attorney for the Natural Resources Defense Council.
Goldman follows industry and companies as an analyst and is also called director; the evidence contains no lawyer or attorney role.
Steinbrenner is described as owner and controlling the Yankees, not their lawyer.
Caplan is a director, bioethicist and professor at the University of Pennsylvania; these do not establish legal representation.
